meta.name: linkedin-post-writer
meta.description: Draft a new LinkedIn post from scratch using one of 20 2026 hook formulas (anaphora, R.I.P., time-anchor, curiosity-gap, contrarian, controlled A/B, false-binary, and more) plus a founders-edition angle library, picked by engagement goal (comments, reposts, likes, saves). Runs the humanizer pass and schedules via Publora on approval. Use to write a post, find a hook or proven format, or get founder-specific angles. Not for reviewing existing drafts (use linkedin-humanizer --mode audit).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把零散想法写成一条抓眼球的 LinkedIn 帖,并按时发布
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常想发 LinkedIn 却卡在开头,还得手动排发布时间。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a rough idea into a scroll-stopping LinkedIn post and schedule it.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to post on LinkedIn but get stuck on the opening line.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能从零起草 LinkedIn 长文帖:按你想要的效果(评论、转发、点赞、收藏)从 16 个钩子公式里挑一个,填进你的语气,过一遍去 AI 味流程,你确认后经 Publora 排期发布。
howto.when: 当你说「帮我写一条 LinkedIn 帖子」,或已有选题、想要一个钩子或现成格式时接管。审改已有草稿不走它(用 linkedin-humanizer --mode audit)。

say.text: 帮我写一条关于我们融资的 LinkedIn 帖子,想要更多评论
say.note: 它会先按目标挑 2-3 个钩子公式给你选

say.text: 我有选题但没钩子,给我几个能用的开头
say.note: 每个方案会附带参考互动数据

say.text: 这篇草稿写好了,帮我过一遍去 AI 味并排期
say.note: 你确认后经 Publora 定时发布

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drafts a LinkedIn post: it picks from 16 hook formulas by your goal (comments, reposts, likes, saves), fills the skeleton in your voice, runs the humanizer pass, and schedules via Publora after you approve.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to write a LinkedIn post, or have a topic and need a hook or proven format. Reviewing existing drafts is out of scope (use linkedin-humanizer --mode audit).

say_en.text: Write me a LinkedIn post about our funding round, aimed at comments
I have a topic but no hook — give me a few openers
say_en.note: Each option shows reference engagement numbers

say_en.text: Humanize this draft and schedule it for me
say_en.note: Publishes via Publora after you approve
